description: This file defines the class 'SugarAuthenticateUser', which handles user authentication, session management, and two-factor authentication logic within a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for verifying user credentials, loading users into session, and managing multi-factor authentication tokens.

classes.name: SugarAuthenticateUser
classes.description: Handles user authentication, session loading, and multi-factor authentication processes within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Verifies user credentials and returns user ID if authentication succeeds, considering external auth disabled users.

methods.name: isSugarLogin
methods.description: Checks if a user is configured to use SugarCRM login based on the provided username and password.

methods.name: loadUserOnLogin
methods.description: Performs user login process, including password hashing, user verification, and session setup.

methods.name: loadUserOnSession
methods.description: Loads the user into the current session based on user ID, verifying if the user is enabled.

methods.name: isUserNeedFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Checks if the current user requires multi-factor authentication.

methods.name: isUserFactorAuthenticated
methods.description: Verifies if the user has completed the factor authentication step.

methods.name: isUserFactorTokenReceived
methods.description: Detects if a factor authentication token was received in the current request.

methods.name: factorAuthenticateCheck
methods.description: Validates and sets the user's multi-factor authentication status based on session or request token.

methods.name: showFactorTokenInput
methods.description: Displays the UI for user to input their multi-factor authentication token, including validation.

methods.name: isFactorTokenSent
methods.description: Checks if a factor token has been sent to the user (typically via email).

methods.name: sendFactorTokenToUser
methods.description: Generates and sends a multi-factor authentication token to the user's email.

methods.name: redirectToLogout
methods.description: Destroys session and redirects the user to the logout page.

methods.name: isUserLogoutRequest
methods.description: Determines if the current request is a logout request for the user.

methods.name: isUserRequestedResendToken
methods.description: Checks if the user has requested to resend the multi-factor authentication token.
